correctness.rationale: Weighted Bergman moment ratios give b_n=sqrt((n+1)/(n+p+1)), p=alpha+1>0; rotation-invariance and convexity reduce the finite compressed shift numerical radius to the maximal eigenvalue of the symmetric Jacobi b_n/2 matrix. With μ_N=1−b_{N−1}, exact edge-energy identity is 1−r_N−μ_N=1/2Σb_n|Δu_n|²+Σ[V_{N,n}−μ_N]|u_n|². Positivity of b_n increments and the last-index boundary barrier localize the ground vector to j=N−n=O(N^{2/3}); rescaled discrete Dirichlet forms converge to q_p(φ)=1/2∫(|φ′|²+p x|φ|²). Smooth compact trials give limsup, energy tightness, boundary control, H1 interpolation compactness and weak lower semicontinuity give liminf and L2 eigenvector convergence. The lowest half-line Dirichlet Airy eigenvalue a1 p^{2/3}/2 and normalized Ai profile follow by scaling. μ_N=p/(2N)+O(N^-2), producing the N^-4/3 term. Independent finite Jacobi eig tests at p=0.5,1,2,4 showed scaled terms approach Airy values, but do not prove the limit.
